QuestInfo.name: Cleaning Up Toy Inventory
QuestInfo.0: Robert Holly from the toy factory has a request for you. Go see Robert Holly.
QuestInfo.1: The toys were left alone too long and now the ghost that used to haunt #b#MDmirrorD_327_2_##k has taken over them. Robert Holly says, the toys should be cleaned up even if it's little too late.
QuestInfo.2: You've organized the toys that were stocked up at #MDmirrorD_327_2_#.

0.0: There are always toy fads. For example, giant ragdolls used to be popular, but now smaller clockwork dolls and robots are in. This factory makes products based on the latest trends.
0.1: We end up getting our old unsold products back. We used to put them in storage in the #blower Clocktower floors#k, but I suppose we've neglected them for too long because the ghosts there took over the toys! We have to do something about that stock, before it runs rampant.

yes.0: Okay, here are the products that need to be taken care of: #rDeath Teddy#k, #rMaster Death Teddy#k, #rSoul Teddy#k, and #rMaster Soul Teddy#k. To be honest, sales of those items have been quite poor, so you probably need to get rid of at least #r18#k of each.

no.0: Have you no sympathy? No compassion?

1.0: Did you take care of those toys in the lower floors of the Clocktower?

yes.0: They're quite cute, so I don't know why they didn't sell well. It is a mystery.

default.0: Still not done? Remember you have to take care of #rDeath Teddy#k, #rMaster Death Teddy#k, #rSoul Teddy#k, and #rMaster Soul Teddy#k! #r18#k of each!
